reviews.text: I had my dog there for two weeks for a board and train. The atmosphere was both loving and fun. She loved every minute and I will bring her back for daily activities . It is a wonderful wonderful place.
Rhoda & the staff took incredible care of my dog, Lupa. She went for Board & Train & has learned so much. I will take her to daycare & recommended their training & care to everyone!

K9s Only is the only place I trust to care for my chihuahua for boarding. I am able to travel comfortably knowing that he is happy and safe. He always happy to arrive which makes drop off easy. I am especially grateful for Azi. For years she has been great at communicated and working with me to make sure Alfredo is as well cared for here as he is at home.

My wife and I booked the 5 week board & train program for our dog, Sugar, and we are so happy we did!! Rhoda worked with sugar to improve her dog reactivity, leash manners, and overall confidence. We can definitely tell a difference in all of those areas! We greatly appreciated the consistent communication/updates throughout the stay. We highly recommend Rhoda and her team!!

We had the best experience with K9s only! Our puppy trained with Rhoda and came back a changed dog. She is great and we love that it was all about positive reinforcement. She trained us how to continue the training at home and it has been going very well. We also love that we found a great place for daycare and boarding for all three of our dogs. They all get so excited to go inside and at the end of the day they are totally wiped out from all the fun.

Great place for dogs to socialize.  My seven month old golden retriever is on his second day there and he is already starting to realize this is a fun place.  The dogs that come in are super excited to be there when getting dropped off. You can tell they look forward coming here.  I plan on keeping my dog in weekly play groups because he is a puppy who needs to burn off his puppy energy during the day.  Also, he is extremely social and loves playing with other dogs. This is a safe space to do that with loving volunteers who clearly are dog lovers. Highly recommend.

I recently rescued my pom and sent her to K9s for training…i recieved daily videos and updates from her awesome trainer Rhoda…most importantly she was socialized with small and big dogs and shes no longer obsessively reacting over other dogs while on our walks…im amazed at her transformation in just 1 week…Rhoda also showed me how to be the leader and i see the diference in how my lil pom is responding to my commands…

We found their grooming department very nice. They provided a top notch service throughout the experience. Shout out to Jasmin, she was the one taking care of the grooming services for our boys. She took the time to listen to our preferences and did everything to make sure they come out looking the way we like them. It’s very important to find a place to deliver fine results aesthetically. More importantly, it seemed like a friendly environment to leave your pets with, as I am inclined to try out their daycare services in future.
Great job guys.
I am absolutely so happy with how they care for my boy. He gets so excited when going in the morning I would highly recommend them

I registered my 1 yr old  American Bully for a 1 week board & training program. I would absolutely recommend K9s Only. Rhoda and Jasmine worked with my pup and they did a great job. My dog never had training before and he's a big boy so I was little nervous but they kept me updated with pictures and videos and assured me that he was doing great. My pup learned a lot and had a great time. I highly recommend K9s Only, they are truly invested in your dogs well being and care about their safety. They ensure that you understand the training they did with your pup  when you pick them up so you can stay consistent at home. They also offer grooming. 10/10!!
